# anthropic_rbac_group_member (Resource)

Manages a user's membership in an API-managed Claude Enterprise RBAC group (`/v1/organizations/rbac_groups/{group_id}/members`). Note that memberships in SCIM-provisioned groups (`source_type = "scim"`) are controlled by your identity provider and cannot be modified via the Admin API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Identifier of the target RBAC group.
- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the organization user to add to the group.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the membership was created.
- `email` (String) Email address of the member.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `<group_id>/<user_id>`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the member.
